changes: Kits comes to Modwerk: 255 Kits per project, and each pattern plays its own. PART loads a Kit, FUNC+PART saves one.
Projects without Kits are migrated the first time: each Part becomes a Kit and its patterns keep playing it.
Uses about 2 MB of sample memory while installed. Works beside other modules; loaded over USB.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
